full_judgment:
2.	Is the suit barred by limitation? 

 1. That the suit is not barred by limitation. 

 20. The finding of the court below that there was an agreement between the plaintiff and defendant No. 1 to sell the suit property and the suit was not barred by limitation have not been assailed in this appeal. On consideration of the pleadings and evidence on record we also agree with the said findings. Admittedly there was an agreement by defendant No. 1 to sell the suit property to the plaintiff at a consideration of Taka 43,00,000.00 out of which defendant No. 1 received an advance of Taka 3,00,000.00 on 15.7.1982 on executing the deed of agreement for sale Ext I. The suit was filed on 23.1.1983 within 3 years from the date of the agreement and as such the suit was filed in time.
